name: Outdoor Garden lounge Set
material: 2*1 teslin fabrics, steel frame w/t powder coated. w/t polyester fabric cushion
description: This garden lounge set made of steel in terracotta is perfect for cozy evenings outdoors. The set consists of a corner sofa and two side tables. The sofa is equipped with a sturdy frame made of terracotta-colored steel. The seat and back cushions are covered with an ecru-colored, water-repellent and removable polyester cover. The side tables have a diameter of 45 cm and 60 cm and are also made of terracotta-colored steel.
